title: To rename section 219(c) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 as the Kay Bailey Hutchison Spousal IRA.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Amends the Internal Revenue Code to rename the section heading of Internal Revenue Code provisions relating to the individual retirement accounts (IRAs) of married individuals as the Kay Bailey Hutchison Spousal IRA.

summary.headline: A 2013 law renames the tax code section on spousal IRAs after former Senator Kay Bailey Hutchison.
summary.what_it_does: This law changes the name of the section heading in the Internal Revenue Code that covers individual retirement accounts for married people. The new name is the Kay Bailey Hutchison Spousal IRA. It is a name change only and does not change how the accounts work, what they cost, or who can use them.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on July 25, 2013.
